verdict.rationale: Superset documents Automations: recurring agent runs that execute a prompt on a cron-like schedule in a fresh or existing workspace, producing a live workspace you can open and continue. AI-native users can manage these programmatically through the CLI, the TypeScript SDK and the MCP server, and a probe confirmed the hosted MCP endpoint (with automation tools) is live behind OAuth. Automations appear only on the paid tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work, detailed docs on schedule syntax and options, and availability on the free tier.
